lines.zh: 对不起，我听不懂。请说慢一点。
lines.py: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ tīng bu dǒng. Qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn.
lines.en: Sorry, I don't understand. Please speak a little slower.

lines.py: Hǎo de. Nǐ shì xuésheng ma?

lines.en: I can speak a little Chinese.

lines.zh: 谢谢！我小时候听过中文。
lines.en: Thanks! I heard Chinese as a kid.

lines.py: Wǒ shuō de tài kuài le ma?
Yǒudiǎnr kuài. Qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn.
lines.en: A bit fast. Please speak a little slower.

lines.zh: 请问，这个用中文怎么说？
lines.py: Qǐngwèn, zhège yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō?
lines.en: Excuse me, how do you say this in Chinese?

lines.py: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?

lines.zh: 不好意思，能帮我一下吗？
lines.py: Bù hǎoyìsi, néng bāng wǒ yíxià ma?
lines.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
How do you say this in Chinese?
Wait a moment… this is called dìtiě (subway).

lines.py: Wǒ shì Jiānádà rén. Nǐ ne?
Wǒ yào zhège, bú yào là.
Zài zhèr chī háishi dài zǒu?
Zài zhèr chī. Wǒ yào yì bēi shuǐ.
lines.en: For here. And a glass of water, please.

lines.zh: 很好吃！我吃饱了。服务员，买单！
lines.py: Hěn hǎochī! Wǒ chī bǎo le. Fúwùyuán, mǎidān!
lines.en: Delicious! I'm full. Waiter, the bill please!

lines.zh: 太贵了！能便宜一点儿吗？
lines.py: Tài guì le! Néng piányi yìdiǎnr ma?
lines.en: Too expensive! Can you make it cheaper?
Excuse me, how much is this?

lines.py: Tài guì le! Shí kuài, kěyǐ ma?
Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.en: How many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 我家有四口人。爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
lines.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. Bàba, māma, jiějie hé wǒ.
lines.en: Four. Dad, mom, my older sister and me.

lines.py: Méiyǒu, wǒ yǒu yì zhī māo.

lines.en: How do I get to the subway station?

lines.zh: 一直往前走，然后往左拐。
lines.py: Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.

lines.en: Not far, five minutes on foot.
What time are you getting up tomorrow?

lines.py: Qī diǎn. Míngtiān shàngwǔ wǒ hěn máng.

lines.en: Do you have time in the afternoon?
Yes. See you in the afternoon!
Long time no see! How have you been?

lines.py: Hái kěyǐ, yǒudiǎnr máng. Nǐ ne?
lines.en: Not bad, a bit busy. And you?

lines.py: Wǒ yě shì. Nǐ chī fàn le ma?

lines.en: What do you want to eat?

lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng chī jiǎozi. Nǐ ne?

lines.en: I'll have a bowl of noodles.

lines.py: Wǒ zài jiā. Nǐ zài zuò shénme?
lines.en: I'm home. What are you doing?

lines.zh: 我在超市买东西。你要什么吗？
lines.py: Wǒ zài chāoshì mǎi dōngxi. Nǐ yào shénme ma?
lines.en: I'm shopping at the supermarket. Do you need anything?

lines.zh: 请给我买一些水果和牛奶。
lines.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ mǎi yìxiē shuǐguǒ hé niúnǎi.
lines.en: Please buy me some fruit and milk.

lines.py: Hǎo de. Wǒ liù diǎn huí jiā.
lines.en: Okay. I'll be home at six.

lines.py: Wǒ néng zuò chūzūchē qù ma?
lines.en: Can I take a taxi there?
Sure, it's ten minutes by car.

lines.py: Yǒudiǎnr lěng, wàibian xià yǔ le.
lines.en: A bit cold, it's raining outside.

lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ xǐhuan xuě.

lines.en: What are you doing on Sunday?

lines.zh: 我想去看电影。你也去吧？
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng. Nǐ yě qù ba?
lines.en: I want to see a movie. You'll come too?

lines.zh: 好啊！看完电影我们去吃饭吧。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Kàn wán diànyǐng wǒmen qù chī fàn ba.
lines.en: Sure! After the movie let's go eat.

lines.zh: 没问题。我知道一个很好的饭店。
lines.py: Méi wèntí. Wǒ zhīdào yí ge hěn hǎo de fàndiàn.
lines.en: No problem. I know a great restaurant.

lines.py: Tā shì wǒ péngyou de péngyou.
lines.en: He's a friend of a friend.
What do you want to eat?

lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng chī jiǎozi. Nǐ ne?
Wǒ mǎi shuǐguǒ. Nǐ yào ma?
Hěn xǐhuan. Nǐ xiǎng kàn ma?
lines.en: Very much. Do you want to read it?

lines.py: Yǒu, wǒ yǒu liǎng ge háizi.
Yí ge liù suì, yí ge bā suì.
lines.en: One is six, one is eight.
Yes, they're both in primary school.

lines.py: Wéi, nǐ hǎo! Nǐ bàba zài jiā ma?

lines.en: What time does he get home?

lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ wǎnshang zài dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: OK, I'll call again this evening.

lines.py: Hǎo ba, wǒ yào liǎng ge.

lines.en: Let's go and see a movie.
Have you been to the hospital?

lines.py: Hěn piàoliang, wǒ huì dú yìdiǎnr.
lines.en: Beautiful. I can read a little.
